# hint in aggregate and update/delete — facts

> Source-anchored units about hint in aggregate and update/delete: 10 across 5 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-21 · 10 units · 5 sources · rights: quote -->

## Structure and components

- [statement] MongoDB 8.0 query-settings documentation says matching cluster query settings take precedence over command-level index hints for a query shape; the server can ignore a command's `hint` when matching query settings contain index hints. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-21) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/command/setquerysettings/ · keywords: hint in aggregate and update/delete · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/aggregate/

## How it works

- [statement] The C Driver's unacknowledged-write guidance lists server hint support as MongoDB 4.2+ for update commands and 4.4+ for delete commands, and says the driver should allow the option only when the server supports it. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2023-10-28) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/CDRIVER-4127 · keywords: hint in aggregate and update/delete · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.updateOne.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.deleteMany.md

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The mongosh updateOne(), updateMany(), deleteOne(), and deleteMany() helpers accept hint to select an index for the operation's query predicate; the option accepts an index name or key pattern, and a nonexistent index makes the operation error. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.updateOne.md · keywords: hint in aggregate and update/delete · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.updateMany.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.deleteOne.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.deleteMany.md
- [statement] For unacknowledged OP_MSG writes, CDRIVER-4127 records a driver-spec change to allow `hint` when the server supports it: MongoDB 4.2 and later for update commands, and 4.4 and later for delete and findAndModify. For older server versions, the driver should raise a client-side error because an unacknowledged write cannot return the server's unsupported-option error. (medium confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/CDRIVER-4127 · keywords: hint in aggregate and update/delete · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.updateOne/, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.deleteOne/

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The aggregate command accepts hint as an index name or key-pattern document and applies it to the initial collection or view; it does not select indexes for $lookup or $graphLookup stages. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/aggregate.md · keywords: hint in aggregate and update/delete · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-3-6-aggregation-and-array-improvements/
- [statement] Driver APIs expose hints differently: PyMongo bulk DeleteOne accepts an optional hint as a string or index-key input, while Mongoose's Query API lists hint under find-only setOptions() options and also exposes Query.prototype.hint(); that page does not clarify whether write methods forward it. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-21) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-python-driver/blob/main/pymongo/operations.py · keywords: hint in aggregate and update/delete · also: https://mongoosejs.com/docs/api/query.html, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.deleteMany.md
- [statement] The aggregate command accepts `hint` as an index name or key-pattern document for the initial collection or view. It does not apply to `$lookup` or `$graphLookup`; Percona's MongoDB 3.6 coverage identifies aggregation `$hint` as a 3.6 feature. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/aggregate/ · keywords: hint in aggregate and update/delete · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-3-6-aggregation-and-array-improvements/
- [statement] `db.collection.updateOne()` and `updateMany()` accept `hint` as an index name or key-pattern document to support the query predicate. If the requested index does not exist, the operation errors. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.updateOne/ · keywords: hint in aggregate and update/delete · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.updateMany/
- [statement] `db.collection.deleteOne()` and `deleteMany()` accept `hint` as an index name or key-pattern document to support the query predicate. If the requested index does not exist, the operation errors. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.deleteOne/ · keywords: hint in aggregate and update/delete · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.deleteMany/
- [statement] Mongoose exposes `Aggregate.prototype.hint(value)` for aggregation queries; the wrapper accepts an index name or hint object. The server command documentation defines the underlying index-name and key-pattern forms. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-21) — https://mongoosejs.com/docs/api/aggregate.html · keywords: hint in aggregate and update/delete · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/aggregate/
